**Static class** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere](/docs/reference/#latiprimere) package.

```csharp
public static class PrinterExtensions
```

Provides helper methods for following printers.

## Methods

### WatchStatusAsync

```csharp
public static IAsyncEnumerable<PrinterStatus> WatchStatusAsync(this IPrinter printer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
```

Follows a printer's state until cancelled, as [IPrinter.WatchStatusAsync](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#watchstatusasync) does, checking it every [PrinterExtensions.DefaultPollInterval](/docs/reference/latiprimere/printerextensions/#defaultpollinterval) when the print system can't say when it changes.

**Parameters**

- `printer`: The printer to follow.
- `cancellationToken`: A token to stop following the printer.

**Returns**

The printer's status, then each change of it.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `printer` is `null`.

## Fields

### DefaultPollInterval

```csharp
public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultPollInterval
```

The interval between state checks used when none is specified, for print systems that can't say when a printer's state changes. Printers change less often than jobs, so it is longer than [PrintJobExtensions.DefaultPollInterval](/docs/reference/latiprimere/printjobextensions/#defaultpollinterval).
